title: ARA LLM Call
description: One row of llm/calls.jsonl. Records a single model invocation with content-addressed message and response payloads. Callers should never inline prompt or response text into this row — everything sizeable lives under objects/ and is referenced by hash.

call_id.description: Unique per invocation; not stable across runs.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the call completed.

stage.description: Which pipeline stage produced the call (ideation / planning / bfts_draft / bfts_debug / review / repair / writeup / …). Free-form.

model.description: Model id as passed by the caller (e.g. anthropic/glm-5.1).

params.description: Hash-worthy request knobs (temperature, max_tokens, seed, top_p, response_format, tool_choice, stop). Non-serialisable values MUST be omitted, not stringified.

error.description: When the call failed after retries, a short description; response_ref then points at empty bytes.
